natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Current activation and onboarding completion are both down 4-6% QoQ. Two of our most relevant prior learnings show that signup simplification (memory_31) and shortening onboarding (memory_86) both drive measurable improvements in early-stage funnel metrics. Verification of these two memories will confirm the specific field reductions and process changes that worked before, allowing us to run a properly calibrated repeat with confidence. This addresses both declining metrics simultaneously without the renewal risk of promotional_pricing (memory_73) or the competitive disadvantage of waiting for referral programs to mature. Activation messaging (memory_91) is additive but won't solve the structural onboarding friction. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is misaligned with the SMB pressure we're facing. A standard experiment on simplified onboarding preserves uncertainty about scale and timing while targeting the root cause of our two degraded metrics.
